blocks.text: Data backup ka matlab hai ahem data ki copy (nakal) banana. Is se data zaya hone ya kharab hone se bachta hai. Data viruses ya hardware kharab hone se zaya ho sakta hai. Backup se data aasani se wapas (restore) laya ja sakta hai. Recovery data wapas hasil karne ka amal hai. Hifazat ke liye backup aur recovery bohat zaroori hain. Har user ko baqaidagi se apne data ka backup lena chahiye.

Data backup ki mukhtalif qismein hain. Full backup sara data ek hi baar mein save karta hai. Incremental backup sirf badla hua data save karta hai. Differential backup aakhri full backup ke baad ki tabdeeliyan save karta hai. Backups hard drives par rakhe ja sakte hain. Cloud storage bhi backup ke liye istemal hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Itwar se Budh tak chaar din ka jadwal. Full: har din sara data. Incremental: Itwar sara data, phir har din sirf us din ki tabdeeli. Differential: Itwar sara data, phir har din Itwar ke baad ki tamam tabdeeli.
blocks.caption: Chaar dinon mein full, incremental aur differential backups (asal khaaka, kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Incremental backup sirf woh data save karta hai jo pichhle kisi bhi backup (full ya incremental) ke baad badla. Yeh sab se chhota aur tez hai, lekin restore ke liye full backup aur us ke baad ka har incremental backup chahiye. Differential backup roz bara hota jata hai, lekin restore ke liye sirf full backup aur aakhri differential kaafi hai.

Data recovery zaya shuda data wapas lane ke liye istemal hoti hai. Recovery ke liye backup files istemal hoti hain. Recovery software delete shuda files wapas lane mein madad deta hai. System restore system ka data wapas la sakta hai. Mahireen (professionals) kharab devices se bhi data nikal sakte hain. Recovery ke tareeqe data ka nuqsan kam karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Itwar ko full backup aur Pir, Mangal aur Budh ko incremental backups liye gaye. Jumeraat ko disk kharab ho gayi. Data bahal karne ke liye kaun se backups chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Itwar ka full backup aur teeno incremental backups (Pir, Mangal aur Budh), tarteeb se. Differential backups ke saath sirf Itwar ka full aur Budh ka differential chahiye hota.

items: Backup: ahem data ki copy; recovery: data wapas lana.
Full: sab kuch; incremental: pichhle backup ke baad badla hua; differential: aakhri full ke baad ki tabdeeliyan.
Recovery: backup files, recovery software, system restore, mahireen.
